title: Simulation 3D Multirotor Pack
text: Generate translation and rotation information for multirotor rotorcraft, 22 inputs, 2 outputs, {Select input coordinate frame} sets Input coordinate frame; {Rotor 1 translation} sets the option to enable Rotor1_T input port, {Rotor 2 translation} sets the option to enable Rotor2_T input port, {Rotor 3 translation} sets the option to enable Rotor3_T input port, {Rotor 4 translation} sets the option to enable Rotor4_T input port, {Rotor 5 translation} sets the option to enable Rotor5_T input port, {Rotor 6 translation} sets the option to enable Rotor6_T input port, {Rotor 7 translation} sets the option to enable Rotor7_T input port, {Rotor 8 translation} sets the option to enable Rotor8_T input port, {Rotor 1 rotation} sets the option to enable Rotor1_R input port, {Rotor 2 rotation} sets the option to enable Rotor2_R input port, {Rotor 3 rotation} sets the option to enable Rotor3_R input port, {Rotor 4 rotation} sets the option to enable Rotor4_R input port, {Rotor 5 rotation} sets the option to enable Rotor5_R input port, {Rotor 6 rotation} sets the option to enable Rotor6_R input port, {Rotor 7 rotation} sets the option to enable Rotor7_R input port, {Rotor 8 rotation} sets the option to enable Rotor8_R input port, {Sensor 1 translation} sets the option to enable Sensor1_T input port, {Sensor 2 translation} sets the option to enable Sensor2_T input port, {Sensor 1 rotation} sets the option to enable Sensor1_R input port and {Sensor 2 rotation} sets the option to enable Sensor2_R input port. Values come from the instance.
